  expected_change_site: The merge-lease env blocks in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (lines 1211-1213, 4730-4732, 4851-4853), `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml` (line 233-234), `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (lines 294-296), `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml` (lines 422-424)
  confidence=4

As a result, setting the repository variable has no effect and metrics stay on.
